note: Written at the conference 'Mathematical Proof in the Age of AI', two days after OpenAI's 6 October release. Harris argues that OpenAI expects mathematicians to verify and explain its papers, casting them as Mechanical Turks, and that using arXiv papers posted under non-commercial licences violated their authors' rights. He quotes reactions from Proofs and Prompts by Alexandre Martin and Enrico Fatighenti. Ignoring the papers is a viable individual strategy, he says, but many call for a collective response.
title: Now all mathematicians can be Mechanical Turks
